p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official sources from each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, open up the official updated sources, then read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Help Service (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for one product and one country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (MAM): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and Duties on Entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Taxes, International Trade, Country by Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): checks that a platform has not been marked by a regulator before entrusting money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand a document" for a document. For a big decision, ask a professional in this country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, shippers and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling across borders. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not require customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Rules for Nearly All Countries · Global Voices
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): Duties, Taxes, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and taxes on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of lading (sea), Bill of lading (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer manages everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods dispatched for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the ship; after that, risks and costs are on the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays for freight and insurance until the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers at destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. These lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the exact rules for your product.
p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the rates in your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money on its own and does not earn anything from these links: compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance Prices Worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash collection in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash collection, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, rates are displayed before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash pick-up
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total you receive: fees + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identity document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stocks: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer. It is easy to start, but you are still responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is permitted in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without authorization.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting the rights of customers: clear prices including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A vendor who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Pay courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and false opinions: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
